# Sherman Art Works

> Handmade glass Judaica and decorative art, crafted in Israel by the Sherman family. We make Hanukkah menorahs, Shabbat candlesticks, Kiddush cups, shofars, mezuzah cases and custom corporate gifts. International shipping $45 · Israel ₪35 · collection from the gallery in Karnei Shomron at no charge.

Sherman Art Works is a family-run artisan studio based in Karnei Shomron, Israel. Three generations of the Sherman family handcraft blown and fused glass Judaica using traditional techniques. All products are made by hand in the studio and shipped internationally. Orders can be paid by card on the site, in shekels or US dollars, or placed via WhatsApp or email.

## Shop

- [Candlesticks](https://shermanartworks.com/candlesticks.html): Handmade glass Shabbat candlesticks in multiple patterns, colors, and styles. Organized into [925 Silver-Plated](https://shermanartworks.com/candlesticks-silver-plated.html) (7 products), [Gold-Plated](https://shermanartworks.com/candlesticks-gold-plated.html) (7 products), [Double-Sided](https://shermanartworks.com/candlesticks-double-sided.html) (10 products), and [Artisanal](https://shermanartworks.com/candlesticks-artisanal.html) (10 products). The double-sided glass family is sold as a pair in white and blue, terracotta, pearl white, dark turquoise, or blue, each with silver-tone or gold-tone sockets and base, for ₪594 per pair. The 925 silver-plated glass family is sold as a pair in white, red, blue, green, black, blue-green, or earth tones, with S (14-18 cm), M (19-22 cm), and L (23-25 cm) heights. A matching tray can be added for ₪447 instead of ₪561. A gold-plated family is sold as a pair in blue, blue-green, red, orange, earth, black, or green, in the same three heights, with a matching gold-plated tray for ₪492 instead of ₪617. Category prices range from ₪505 to ₪862 per pair. - [Hanukkah Menorahs](https://shermanartworks.com/hanukkah-menorahs.html): Modern, colorful handmade glass Hanukkah menorahs (hanukkiot, also called Chanukah menorahs) in three shapes, [half-moon](https://shermanartworks.com/hanukkah-menorahs-half-moon.html), [rectangular](https://shermanartworks.com/hanukkah-menorahs-rectangular.html) and [trapezoid](https://shermanartworks.com/hanukkah-menorahs-trapezoid.html). Every shape is 33 cm long, 27 cm high and 3 cm deep, made of double-sided glass, in eight glass colors (pearl white, blue, white and blue, clear, emerald green, light blue, terracotta, turquoise), each with silver-tone or gold-tone sockets and base; the sockets and base are not plated. Every menorah is ₪1,250 ($420), in any shape and either finish. Hanukkah price until December 4, 2026: ₪1,000 ($336), 20% off. Most are made to order and ship within 14 business days; some are in stock and ship right away. Each is a kosher Hanukkah menorah: eight lights in a straight row at one height, with the shamash set apart. It takes standard Hanukkah candles, or oil cups in the sockets, and the base (4.5 cm radius) stands steadily on a narrow windowsill. Other colors and custom designs on request. ## Guides

- [Buying Guides](https://shermanartworks.com/guides.html): All of our buying guides in one place.
- [How to Choose a Kiddush Cup](https://shermanartworks.com/kiddush-cup-guide.html): Buyer's guide from the makers. How much a Kiddush cup should hold (at least a revi'it: about 86 ml / 2.9 fl oz per Rabbi Chaim Na'eh, about 150 ml / 5.1 fl oz per the Chazon Ish), glass or ceramic, 925 silver-plated or gold-plated rims and how to care for them, tall (about 21 cm) or low (about 9.5 cm) cups, matching 15 cm glass plates, and which cup suits which gift. Hebrew version: https://shermanartworks.com/he/kiddush-cup-guide.html
- [How to Choose Shabbat Candlesticks](https://shermanartworks.com/shabbat-candlesticks-guide.html): Buyer's guide from the makers. Why candlesticks come in pairs (two candles, zachor and shamor), heights for 925 silver-plated and gold-plated pairs (S 14-18 cm, M 19-22 cm, L 23-25 cm), 925 silver-plated, gold-plated or all-glass artisanal pairs, matching trays, removing wax, and candlesticks as gifts. Hebrew version: https://shermanartworks.com/he/shabbat-candlesticks-guide.html
- [How to Choose a Havdalah Set](https://shermanartworks.com/havdalah-set-guide.html): Buyer's guide from the makers. What Havdalah needs (wine, spices, a multi-wick candle), what our sets include (a stemmed cup, a lidded spice box, a candle holder and a matching tray), 925 silver-plated colors (black, blue, white, orange) and gold-plated colors (black, blue, white, orange, red), care, and Havdalah sets as gifts. Hebrew version: https://shermanartworks.com/he/havdalah-set-guide.html
- [How to Choose a Shofar](https://shermanartworks.com/shofar-guide.html): Kudu or ram's horn (the ram's horn is the traditional shofar for Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur, 30-65 cm; the long spiraled kudu horn is used in Yemenite communities, up to 129 cm), our sizes, 925 silver-decorated designs or custom engraving (a symbol plus an optional Hebrew or English inscription), how to blow (tekiah, shevarim, teruah) and care. Hebrew version: https://shermanartworks.com/he/shofar-guide.html
- [Jewish Wedding Gift Ideas](https://shermanartworks.com/jewish-wedding-gift-guide.html): Shabbat candlesticks (in many families the bride receives her first pair before the wedding), a Kiddush cup with a matching plate, a Havdalah set, a mezuzah case for the first home (case only; the parchment is bought separately from a scribe), and matching pieces for group gifts. Hebrew version: https://shermanartworks.com/he/jewish-wedding-gift-guide.html
- [Bar and Bat Mitzvah Gift Ideas](https://shermanartworks.com/bar-bat-mitzvah-gift-guide.html): A first Kiddush cup of their own, a smaller pair of candlesticks for a bat mitzvah, a shofar engraved with a symbol and their name, a Havdalah set, and one design for every bar and bat mitzvah of a synagogue's year. Hebrew version: https://shermanartworks.com/he/bar-bat-mitzvah-gift-guide.html
- [How to Choose a Mezuzah Case](https://shermanartworks.com/mezuzah-guide.html): The scroll is what makes a mezuzah (handwritten on parchment by a qualified scribe, checked twice every seven years) and our cases are sold without it; natural kudu, ram or oryx horn cases plated in 925 silver, or clear glass; where to hang it (right-hand doorpost, upper third; slanted for Ashkenazim, upright for Sephardim); and mezuzah cases as housewarming or wedding gifts. Hebrew version: https://shermanartworks.com/he/mezuzah-guide.html
- [How to Choose a Hanukkah Menorah](https://shermanartworks.com/hanukkah-menorah-guide.html): What a Hanukkah menorah needs (eight lights in a straight row at one height, plus a shamash set apart; Shulchan Aruch, Orach Chaim 671-673), candles or oil (both allowed; many prefer olive oil), our three shapes (Half-Moon, Rectangular, Trapezoid, all 33 x 27 x 3 cm, double-sided handmade glass), eight glass colors, silver-tone or gold-tone sockets and base (a finish, not plating), where it stands, safety, cleaning wax off glass, and a menorah as a gift. Hebrew version: https://shermanartworks.com/he/hanukkah-menorah-guide.html
- [How to Light the Hanukkah Menorah](https://shermanartworks.com/how-to-light-hanukkah-candles.html): The three blessings in Hebrew, transliteration and English (Shehecheyanu on the first night only), one candle on the first night up to eight plus the shamash, placing right to left and lighting the newest first, when and where to light, at least 30 minutes after nightfall, Friday (before the Shabbat candles) and Saturday night (after Shabbat ends), Hanerot Halalu and Maoz Tzur, Ashkenazi and Sephardi customs, and a night-by-night table for Hanukkah 2026 (first candle Friday, December 4, last candles Friday, December 11). Hebrew version: https://shermanartworks.com/he/how-to-light-hanukkah-candles.html
- [Hanukkah Gift Ideas](https://shermanartworks.com/hanukkah-gift-guide.html): A handmade glass menorah first, then Shabbat candlesticks and a Kiddush cup (Hanukkah 2026 includes two Fridays), a Havdalah set (Saturday night of Hanukkah), and glass trays and bowls for the host; 20% off Hanukkah menorahs until December 4, 2026; some pieces are in stock and ship right away; shipping ₪35 in Israel, $45 international. Hebrew version: https://shermanartworks.com/he/hanukkah-gift-guide.html
- [Menorah or Hanukkiah? The Difference](https://shermanartworks.com/menorah-vs-hanukkiah.html): The seven-branched Temple menorah (Exodus 25:31-40) versus the nine-light Hanukkah menorah or hanukkiah, the story of Hanukkah (rededication of the Temple on 25 Kislev, about 164 BCE), why eight nights (Talmud Shabbat 21b), what the shamash is for, Hanukkah or Chanukah spelling, the menorah as Israel's emblem since 1949, and our pieces that carry the menorah symbol. Hebrew version: https://shermanartworks.com/he/menorah-vs-hanukkiah.html
